QuestInfo.name: Gaga's Favorite Song
QuestInfo.0: Look what you found! A Pop Star's Hit Songs CD... You wonder what you could do with this?
QuestInfo.1: After giving much thought as to what you should do with the Pop Star's Hit Songs CD, you decided to give it to Gaga as a gift. He was begging me for it after all... Wait a minute! Could it be that Gaga never gave up on his secret dream of becoming a pop star himself?
